name: fm27-roshn-saudi-league
note: Stills (FM27 Steam screenshots, dev-build watermark cropped off, 2.0x). The Roshn Saudi League (all 18 clubs, official logos, kits, player photos) is a new licensed league in Football Manager 27, per footballmanager.com news 27 Oct 2026 (regional story the wider press barely carried). The RSL logo from FM's own announcement header sits in the photo window on the cover. Trailer not used: the only Steam trailer carries burnt-in English subtitles and narration about the match engine throughout. Our bed (stills).
